svg.aria-label: Agents forget you. Who you are and how you work load first, whole, in every session. They ignore your rules. A guard on every tool call denies what you ruled out: git push waits for your yes. Nobody writes it down. Sessions, commits and decisions record themselves. Each tool keeps its own memory. Claude Code, Codex, opencode and the Claude app read one vault.
